title: Python: restart-safe airtime restrictions
description:
Connect accounting lifecycle in python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py to startup/shutdown in python/src/lichen/node.py. Restore valid active restrictions across restart or conservatively wait out the applicable window when elapsed time or saved state cannot be trusted. Reconnect, plan changes and wall-clock corrections must not provide a fresh airtime allowance. Keep persistence failure visible to radio admission.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Use existing lifecycle/storage patterns only where they fit; a correct conservative wait-out satisfies the contract without a speculative new persistence framework. Airtime history is distinct from link replay and schedule generations. Do not alter key export/import, replay persistence, radio-owned identity or audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals. Baseline SCHC, security and best-effort custody policies remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Use vectors.09's independent interval ledger and restart traces through the production lifecycle. Cover restart within a restriction, missing/corrupt state, persistence failure, unknown downtime, clock corrections and exact wait-out expiry. Assert no radio transmission becomes eligible merely from restarting and valid elapsed time releases restrictions only at the independently specified boundary. Extend python/tests/timing/test_duty_cycle.py and python/tests/test_node.py; run scoped pytest and ruff.
